title: Real McCoy Snackfood Co - proposed acquisition of Snack Foods Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commences review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Real McCoy Snackfood Co - acquisition of Snack Foods Limited
body_sections.Market definition: The proposed acquisition was assessed within the context of the national market for the manufacture and distribution of salty snacks.
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 22 May 2008, the ACCC formed the view that the acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant market. Factors informing this conclusion included: - the increase in the concentration of manufacturers of salty snack foods in Australia as a result of the acquisition was less than 1%;  and - competitors such as  Frito-Lay remained in the market as vigorous and effective competitors to The Real McCoy.
